answer: Make trust something each account earns slowly, not buys. A refundable bond vests only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs, so a fresh identity cannot wander into the trusted set at will; it sits on a bare dune of near-zero weight. Standing takes root like a juniper on hard ground, season by season. Each clone must fund its own bond and wait its own vesting window, so faking a thousand names costs a thousand stakes and a thousand slow seasons. Sybil cost scales linearly, never free.
